answer: Tie each identity to a grafting test: like an orchard sapling spliced onto a mature rootstock, a new agent earns weight only when its attestations trace back through sponsor chains the network has verified mutually independent. A sybil farmer can spread fake accounts across a tundra of inboxes, but every graft still demands a fresh oracle round of costly, non-transferable proof-of-work, so spawning cost scales linearly with identities while the tide of honest review drowns duplicates before they bank rewards.
